text: Contact follow-up eased to 85.3% (20 888/24 479) from the printed 85.7%. Tshopo sits at 59.1% (191/323), Bas-Uele at 70.4% (107/152) and Haut-Uele at 76.1% (900/1 183). text: PoE/PoC operation stays weak: national report completeness 76.2%, with Bas-Uele at 34.6% (9 of 26 expected), Sud-Kivu 55.5% (5/9) and Haut-Uele 64.0% (7/11), where four points (Dusu, Apodo, Aungba, Gossamu) transmitted nothing for lack of internet. Only 9.1% of Ituri's strategic points are functional: Avakubi is down for insecurity, four points (Nzebi, Galay, Pluto, Bey) are on strike over non-payment and two (Chamugamba, Pabiri) are unreachable; Tshopo has activated 18 of 30 planned PoC.
